## 👨‍💻 About me

I'm a freelance web & mobile developer based in France. I help clients ship real products, end to end: web apps, mobile apps, dashboards and APIs, from the first architecture decisions to deployment and monitoring.

On my own time I design, build and launch my own apps, which keeps me close to the full product cycle: idea, prototype, ship, listen to users, iterate. My current lineup is [Destiny FC](https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/destiny-fc-carri%C3%A8re-foot/id6798603090), [RallyTrack](https://rally-track.com) and [Pedantix](https://pedantix.vercel.app).

I trained at 42, where I cut my teeth on C and low-level systems before falling in love with the web.

- 🔭 Currently: freelance client work + my own products
- 🔧 Main stack: Next.js · React Native · TypeScript · NestJS · Supabase
- 🌱 Always exploring: new tools that make shipping faster
- 💼 Available for freelance projects, from MVP to production
- 📫 Best way to reach me: **maxime.lngls21@gmail.com**
- 🏃 Off the keyboard: trail runner
